project.name: RuralStroke-Assist
project.product_framing: Research stroke-screening and triage-support prototype; not a diagnosis.

environment.notes: The selected environment loads all three learned baseline artifacts. AutoKeras is retained in the environment because it is part of the historical experiment stack; this phase does not run training.

face.input_contract: RGB image tensor shaped (batch, 160, 160, 3), float values expected in the model's [0,1] input convention.
face.preprocessing_contract: RGB conversion, resize to 160x160, float32 scaling to [0,1]; MobileNetV2 preprocessing is inside the model.
face.output_contract: Binary sigmoid tensor shaped (batch, 1); branch-specific face evidence score interpreted as the Stroke-class score, not a calibrated clinical probability.
face.dataset_provenance: data/processed/face_split_manifest.csv; cleaned annotated facial images for stroke classification; Trial 003.
face.scientific_limitations: Public proxy dataset, unknown subject independence beyond exact-hash deduplication, no clinical validation, and no guarantee that the label represents acute facial weakness.
face.integration_status: Artifact-backed notebook helper only; not connected to the live modules or canonical fusion.

speech.input_contract: DataFrame with the 37 ordered features listed in the speech feature contract; no path, label, speaker, group, or split columns.
speech.preprocessing_contract: Mono audio resampled to 16000 Hz and limited to 5 seconds; 13 MFCC means, 13 MFCC standard deviations, duration, and acoustic summary statistics.
speech.output_contract: Binary control/dysarthric class score/probability from a Random Forest pipeline; branch-specific speech abnormality evidence, not stroke probability.
speech.dataset_provenance: data/processed/speech_split_manifest.csv and data/processed/speech_features.csv; TORGO proxy; Trial 001 speaker-held-out evaluation.
speech.scientific_limitations: TORGO dysarthria is not stroke-specific; microphone/session grouping and domain shift require review; no clinical speech validation.
speech.integration_status: Serialized artifact verified but no runtime speech adapter exists; not connected to canonical fusion.

metadata_context.input_contract: DataFrame with ordered features age, hypertension, heart_disease, avg_glucose_level, bmi, gender, ever_married, work_type, Residence_type, smoking_status.
metadata_context.preprocessing_contract: Median numeric imputation and scaling; most-frequent categorical imputation; one-hot encoding with unknown-category handling.
metadata_context.output_contract: Contextual stroke-risk ranking score/probability from Logistic Regression; background evidence only, not an acute clinical probability.
metadata_context.dataset_provenance: data/processed/metadata_split_manifest.csv; Kaggle Stroke Prediction Dataset; accepted metadata Trial 001/MVP risk artifact.
metadata_context.scientific_limitations: Severely imbalanced general risk-factor dataset, not acute triage data; low positive precision and poor absolute calibration; capture PatientMetadata is not the trained feature contract.
metadata_context.integration_status: Artifact verified but no runtime metadata adapter exists; legacy runtime uses separate hand-written rules.

acute_symptoms.input_contract: AcuteStrokeSymptoms with FAST/BE-FAST booleans, optional onset minutes, and resolved-symptom flag.
acute_symptoms.preprocessing_contract: Pydantic validation of boolean/optional integer fields; no learned preprocessing.
acute_symptoms.output_contract: AcuteSymptomAssessmentResult with score in [0,1], LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/URGENT band, evidence, warnings, and hard_escalation.
acute_symptoms.dataset_provenance: No labeled dataset; deterministic rules audited on stored synthetic scenarios in reports/experiments/acute_symptom_scenario_audit.csv.
acute_symptoms.scientific_limitations: Hand-specified and not clinically validated; simplified symptom severity, laterality, temporal progression, and resolution semantics.
acute_symptoms.integration_status: Canonical source for Phase 0; not connected to AssessmentInput or live model runtime.

fusion.input_contract: FusionInput with optional normalized face, speech, acute symptom, and metadata-context scores in [0,1], plus acute symptom hard escalation.
fusion.preprocessing_contract: Caller supplies normalized branch-specific evidence scores; available weights are renormalized when modalities are missing.
fusion.output_contract: FusionResult with fused screening score, LOW/MODERATE/HIGH/URGENT band, contributions, normalized weights, evidence, and warnings.

class_mapping.MODERATE: fused score at least moderate threshold
class_mapping.HIGH: fused score at least high threshold

fusion.dataset_provenance: No paired multimodal dataset; stored synthetic scenario audit in reports/experiments/fusion_scenario_audit.csv.
fusion.scientific_limitations: Heuristic late fusion with fixed weights and synthetic audit only; score is not calibrated clinical risk; no contradiction or prospective validation study.
fusion.integration_status: Canonical design and test target; not yet connected to real modality adapters or the legacy report path.

legacy_fusion.output_contract: Legacy FusionResult with final_risk_score, triage_level, confidence, evidence, and warnings.
legacy_fusion.dataset_provenance: Legacy smoke-test path; not trained-model backed.
legacy_fusion.scientific_limitations: Uses placeholder face/speech modules, older three-input weights, and no acute symptom override or missing-modality handling.
legacy_fusion.integration_status: Retained for compatibility and explicitly non-canonical.

fer2013_auxiliary.preprocessing_contract: RGB conversion and 160x160 resize with MobileNetV2 preprocessing.
fer2013_auxiliary.output_contract: Seven-class facial-expression softmax; not fusion evidence.
fer2013_auxiliary.scientific_limitations: Emotion recognition is not stroke detection and must not be used as clinical evidence.
fer2013_auxiliary.integration_status: Historical notebook artifact only; excluded from canonical fusion.

fusion.score_semantics: Research screening estimate assembled from branch-specific evidence; not calibrated clinical probability.
